name: LA Metro Trainpack
author: NoahGarrf
description:
This mod replaces base game trains with their real life LA metro counterparts, this is different from a lot of other train mods because instead of adding new trains it simply modifies the base game trains.

The advantage of this method is you can open the save without the mod installed and it will remain fully functional. As such you can place it on existing saves and the trains will change into the modded stats, or you can load the modded save without the mod and they will revert to their base game stats. This also allows you to easily submit bug reports or share your modded saves without worrying about someone else needing the mod

The Modified Train types are:
Heavy Rail-->Breda A650
Light Metro-->Sepulveda
Light Rail-->P3010 LRV
Commuter Rail-->Diesel Metrolink set with bilevels
